groups.title: DynamoDB Design Patterns

followUps.Global Secondary Indexes for Alternative: What does a global secondary index cost you, and why should you plan your indexes before launch?

groups.title: S3 as a Serverless Data Store

followUps.RDS Proxy for Database Connections: Why can Lambda scaling break a relational database, and how does RDS Proxy help?
